mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY QNA_ID DESC) RNUM, QNA_ID AS QNA_NO, TITLE AS QNA_TITLE, QNA_NAME, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS QNA_DATE FROM QNA_POSTS
mapper.insert:
SELECT TICKET_DEV.ISEQ$$_75850.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO QNA_POSTS ( QNA_ID, /* selectKey를 통해 미리 뽑아온 번호를 주입 */ MEMBER_ID, QNA_NAME, TITLE, CONTENT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{QNA_ID}, #{MEMBER_ID, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{QNA_NAME, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TITLE, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{CONTENT, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO ATTACHMENTS ( ATTACHMENT_ID, POST_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, SAVED_NAME, EXTENSION, FILE_SIZE, UPLOADED_AT ) VALUES ( TICKET_DEV.ISEQ$$_75842.NEXTVAL, /* 첨부파일 시퀀스 */ #{POST_ID, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, // QNA 게시글 번호 #{ORIGINAL_NAME, jdbcType=VARCHAR},/* CommonController가 찾는 컬럼 규격 동기화 */ #{SAVED_NAME, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, /* CommonController가 찾는 컬럼 규격 동기화 */ #{EXTENSION, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{FILE_SIZE, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT ATTACHMENT_ID AS FILE_ID, /* jsp 화면단 ${row.FILE_ID} 일치용 */ POST_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME AS ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME, /* jsp 화면단 ${row.ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME} 일치용 */ ORIGINAL_NAME AS UPLOAD_ORIGIN_NAME, /* CommonController 매핑용 백업 */ SAVED_NAME AS UPLOAD_SAVE_NAME, /* CommonController 매핑용 백업 */ FILE_SIZE AS FILE_SIZE /* jsp 화면단 ${row.FILE_SIZE} 일치용 */ FROM ATTACHMENTS WHERE POST_ID = #{QNA_ID}
